thi-ap29:1.1: Kappe ca satasahasse ca caturo ca asaṅkhiye / Dīpaṅkaro nāma jino uppajji lokanāyako. // //
thi-ap29:2.1: Dīpaṅkaro mahāvīro viyākāsi vināyako / Sumedhañ ca Sumittañ ca samānasukhadukkhataṃ // //
thi-ap29:3.1: Sadevakañ ca passanto vicaranto sadevakaṃ / tesaṃ pakittane amha *upaggamma* samāgamaṃ. // //
thi-ap29:4.1: Amhaṃ sabbā patī honti anāgatasamāgame / sabbā va tuyhaṃ bhariyā manāpā piyavādikā. // //
thi-ap29:5.1: Dānasīlam ayaṃ sabbaṃ bhāvanaṃ ca subhāvitaṃ / dīgharattaṃ mayaṃ sabbaṃ pariccattaṃ mahāmune // //
thi-ap29:6.1: Gandhaṃ vilepanaṃ mālaṃ dīpañ ca ratanāmayaṃ / yaṃ kiñci patthitaṃ sabbaṃ pariccattaṃ mahāmune // //
thi-ap29:7.1: Aññaṃ cāpi kataṃ kammaṃ paribhogañ ca mānusaṃ / dīgharattaṃ no sabbaṃ pariccattaṃ mahāmuni. // //
thi-ap29:8.1: Anekajātisaṃsāraṃ bahuṃ puññam hi no kataṃ / issaram anubhotvāna saṃsaritvā bhavābhave. // //
thi-ap29:9.1: Pacchime bhavasampatte Sakyaputta-nivesane / nānākulupapannāyo accharā kāmavaṇṇinī. // //
thi-ap29:10.1: Lābhaggena *yasa*ppattā pūpitā sabba-sakkatā / lābhiyo annapānānaṃ sadā sammānitā mayaṃ. // //
thi-ap29:11.1: Agāraṃ pajahitvāna pabbajiṃ anagāriyaṃ / aṭṭhamāse asampatte sabbā patt' amha nibbutiṃ. // //
thi-ap29:12.1: Lābhiyo annapanānaṃ vatthaṃ se*nā*sanāni ca / upenti paccayā sabbe sadā sakkata-pūjitā.
thi-ap29:16.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ Yasovatī pamukhāni dasabhikkhu*nī* sahassāni bhagavato sammukhā i. g. a-ti. *Āyumāni Yasodharāpamukhānaṃ
